panel.title: Browser
panel.pickProject: Choose a project on the left for the Browser.
panel.localNote: This browser opens in its own window on this computer; agents can't drive it.
panel.localUnavailable: A local browser can't be opened in this environment.
panel.closedNote: The browser is closed. When opened, it starts on the Mac mini with this project's own Chrome profile.

address.invalid: This address can't be opened (too long or invalid).
address.empty: Type an address or something to search for.
address.onlyWeb: Only http(s) addresses can be opened.
address.badSearchEngine: The search engine setting is invalid (it must be an http(s) address containing %s).
address.searchTooLong: The search text is too long.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.needAbsolutePath: Type the full path of the folder on the Mac mini (starting with /).
extensions.folder: Extension folder (on the Mac mini, containing manifest.json)
extensions.webStoreNote: Chrome Web Store extensions are installed once in the profile's own window: Chrome shows the install prompt in its own window, not in this panel. Turn on "{label}", connect to {machine} with Screen Sharing and install it there, then hide the window again; the extension stays in the profile.

window.hint: Show temporarily for Chrome's own windows — sync confirmation, extension pop-ups
window.label: Show on {machine}'s screen

page.noClipboard: The clipboard can't be written in this environment.
page.pasteTooLarge: The clipboard text is too large: at most {max} characters can be pasted.
